SHARP PHYSICAL-TIME PASSAGE-MOMENT CONSEQUENCE
Original lane extension, frozen before blind argument exposure. 8 October 2026.
Status: reconstructed consequence of REPORT Sections2-5 and Lo--Wade Theorems2.3--2.4. Endpoint moment unresolved.

For kappa>2lambda define alpha=1/2-lambda/kappa in(0,1/2).
For each queried moment s, choose a sufficiently large integer K=K(s) and start at(n,0),n>K. Let T_K be the first physical time hitting the finite axis set{(a,0):a<=K}. Then
  E T_K^s < infinity if0<=s<alpha, for every fixed n>K;
  E T_K^s = infinity if s>alpha, for all sufficiently large n.
The cutoff size is allowed to depend on the queried moment s, as in the imported theorem. No assertion at s=alpha or uniform-in-s cutoff size is made. At kappa=2lambda, for every s>0 and all sufficiently large K(s), E T_K^s is infinite for every sufficiently large n, although T_K<infinity almost surely.

DISCRETE PASSAGE THEOREM
For return-chain tau_K=min{j:Z_j<=K}, the imported Lo--Wade results with a singleton line and c=lambda/kappa,s²=1 give:
Theorem2.3: finiteness when2c+(2theta-1)<0, i.e.theta<alpha, for all moments0<=s<=theta (choose arbitrarily large p using exponential moments).
Theorem2.4: infiniteness for every s>=theta when theta>alpha, for all sufficiently large starting n.
Taking theta between the queried s and alpha proves the strict inequalities. When alpha=0, choose0<theta<=s to obtain infiniteness of every positive moment.

PHYSICAL CLOCK: A COMPLETE MOMENT TRANSFER
Continue the cycle process forever even after its first hit on the axis set. Let R_j be cycle durations and H_j their initial B=0 holds.
Section2 gives fixed theta>0,M<infinity such that E[exp(theta R_j)|past]<=M, uniformly in the current A. For deterministic m,
  E exp(theta sum_{j<m}R_j)<=M^m.
Thus, with m=floor(delta*t),delta>0 sufficiently small,
  P(T_K>t)<=P(tau_K>m)+exp(-c*t)
for all large t, because on tau_K<=m the passage time is at most the first m continued cycle durations.
Conversely,H_j are iid Exp(lambda) and independent of the entire event skeleton determining tau_K. T_K>=sum_{j<tau_K}H_j. For m=ceil(2lambda*t), Chernoff's inequality for the Gamma(m,lambda) sum gives
  P(T_K>t)>=P(tau_K>m)*(1-exp(-c'*t)).
The two tail comparisons and the identity E Y^s=s integral_0^infinity t^(s-1)P(Y>t)dt show that T_K and tau_K have exactly the same finite/infinite positive moment classification

POST-PHASE-ONE REFINEMENT AUDIT — 8 OCTOBER 2026
Requested by root after phase-one INTEGRATION.txt was written.
This adds two scoped consequences; it does not assess the unfinished
EPR-matroid or common-metric geometry lanes or alter their priority.

1. Entropy-production no-go with exact visible path-KL saturation: PASS.

The additional entropy_blind_audit/REPORT.txt Section4 assumes an injective
base observation h(i)=i and retains the complete visible jump record,
including physical timing. Appended trap/copy states duplicate their base
labels and have only reciprocal bridges with equal stationary flux.

For a stationary microscopic path, its forward-versus-reversed log RN
derivative is the sum of stationary edge flux affinities. Each appended
bridge has zero affinity. Each active i->j jump is visible and contributes
log[(pi_i q_ij)/(pi_j q_ji)]; the dormant layer has no internal jumps.
Therefore the entire microscopic log RN derivative is a measurable
functional F of the visible jump record. If P_full is the forward law,
Q_full its reversed law, and dP_full/dQ_full=exp(F(Z)), conditional
expectation under Q_full gives

  dP_visible/dQ_visible=exp(F(Z)).

Consequently data processing is exactly saturated:

  D(P_visible || R_*P_visible)
    =D(P_full || R_*P_full)=T*p*sigma_A.

I checked the stationary endpoint telescoping, zero-affinity bridges,
reversal-compatible observation, RN pushforward, and physical-time EP
normalization. The conclusion holds for both the single trap and
all-state dormant-copy constructions. It is a mathematical measurability
statement; it does not supply the numerical affinities to the estimator.

This strengthens the diagnosis of the alpha/c ceiling: its cause need
not be irreversible information erased by observation. Uniform honesty
can fail to permit reliable fractional certification even when the
observed path KL equals microscopic EP at every finite horizon. The
dormant-copy construction also preserves the visible stationary marginal
exactly, so supplying visible occupancies does not eliminate this family.
These are new deductions in the blind-audit extension, rather than a
new variational/betting estimator. The overhead is |S| appended dormant
states and |S| reciprocal bridge pairs.

The saturation conclusion needs injective BASE labels and a sufficiently
complete visible record; extra grid sampling/coarsening can lose it.
